planning_notes: Board is arduino:avr:uno. DHT11 data pin and TM1637 CLK/DIO pins are taken from the authoritative wiring provided: DHT on D7; TM1637 CLK=D4, DIO=D2; fan PWM on D5.
No explicit serial reporting or serial command inputs were provided in the requirements; therefore serial_channels is empty.
DHT sample_period_ms and validity retention behavior are handled by the catalog defaults plus model logic; port configuration uses invalid_policy=hold_last_valid for dht_valid.
TM1637 range handling, rounding, threshold mapping to fan PWM, and display formatting are assumed to be implemented in the SysML model (no additional port objects are created).
Analog/pwm scaling factors are not specified in the requirements; the application/model will apply any necessary mapping from temperature/threshold logic to PWM duty.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Fan speed command (PWM). Model turns fan on when temperature exceeds threshold.

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: Ambient relative humidity reading from DHT11.

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: Validity flag for the latest coherent DHT11 temperature/humidity frame.

interfaces.name: io_4
interfaces.meaning: Display temperature on TM1637 (number selection handled in model).
